# SA5011 — guff reports a nil dereference upstream does not. Upstream's IR has
# σ (sigma) nodes that refine a value along a branch; guff's does not, so the
# nil-checked branch does not narrow the pointer. docs/COMPAT-HARDENING.md §7.
consul guff-only agent/consul/catalog_endpoint.go:280:staticcheck:possible nil pointer dereference

# SA9008 ×2 — `if err, ok := err.(HTTPError); ok { … } else { … err … }` inside a
# range loop. guff's pattern now matches upstream's exactly (2026-08-09), and
# upstream *does* report this shape outside a loop; what suppresses it here is
# the IR verification guff has not ported — upstream drops the read when its IR
# value is not the type-assert result. docs/COMPAT-HARDENING.md §5 carries the
# minimal reproduction. Also the remaining `extra` in the staticcheck-sa golden.
consul guff-only agent/event_endpoint_test.go:115:staticcheck:err refers to the result of a failed type assertion and is a zero value, not the value that was being type-asserted
